content.title: About
content.content: Frozen coffee drink, nonfat is a refreshing beverage made from cold coffee without any added dairy fat. It contains caffeine, flavorings and sweeteners, but virtually no calories or fat, making it popular among weight‑watchers.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink is often served as a granita or frozen cubes that melt in the mouth, creating a light foam.
Lack of fat preserves a brighter coffee flavor without buttery notes.
In many countries it is sold in ready‑to‑drink plastic cups that can be microwaved.
Caffeine content is comparable to regular cold coffee – about 80‑100 mg per 250 ml.
Vanilla, caramel or cinnamon extracts are sometimes added to enhance taste.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Boosts alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving concentration and reducing fatigue.

items.title: Supports metabolism
items.content: Caffeine may increase metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: The absence of fat makes the drink virtually calorie‑free, suitable for diet plans.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: As a liquid beverage, it contributes to overall water balance.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: People sensitive to caffeine may experience anxiety, insomnia or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sweetener content
items.content: Some versions use artificial sweeteners that can cause discomfort in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Cold shock
items.content: Consuming a very cold drink may cause tooth or throat discomfort for those with sensitive enamel.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain medications, such as stimulants or antidepressants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the frozen coffee drink, nonfat right after thawing to keep its refreshing character. It can be blended into smoothies, used as a cocktail base, or topped with nonfat whipped cream for a smoother taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the product in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. Once opened, consume within 1‑2 weeks to prevent crystal formation and flavor changes.
